none: PAS NLM-1C5806: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), Urbs Roma commemorative issue, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Helmeted bust of Roma left. Obverse inscription: VRBS ROMA. Reverse description: Wolf suckling twins. In exergue: TRP, for Trier mint. Diameter: 17.6mm, Weight: 1.86gms, die axis: 6
